title: Never fix failing test by deletion or skipping
context: Tests are the only way to prevent regressions, especially critical ones. The repository treats test failures as signals that either code or test is wrong, never as optional.
decision: A failing test is never fixed by deleting it or skipping it. If a test is genuinely wrong, say so explicitly in the commit message and change it in a separate commit about that change only.
consequences: Developers must diagnose and fix the actual problem, not silence the alarm. This takes more time but prevents silent regressions. Per STANDARDS.md §8, a bug fix arrives with the test that would have caught it—this is the one test rule described as non-negotiable.
